prose: A 2026 class action complaint alleges Google Gemini read Gmail users' emails without consent, framing the claims under privacy and wiretap/CIPA theories. The tracking page is careful about status: these are unproven allegations, Google disputes them, there is no certified class, no settlement, and nothing to claim yet.

The page itself is a general-information explainer, not legal advice - one of thousands of settlement-tracking pages the site maintains. The case joins a growing docket of suits testing whether AI features layered onto existing communication products require fresh consent.
highlights: Class action alleges Google Gemini read user emails without consent.
Filed under privacy and wiretap/CIPA theories in 2026.
Status: allegations only - no certified class, no settlement, Google disputes the claims.
Part of a broader wave of consent litigation around AI features in communication products.
